crossRefs.note: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

translations.web: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.
translations.bsb: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; let the fish of the sea inform you.
translations.kjv: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare
translations.asv: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee; And the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
